summary: Retest of Stripe payment_methods fix in /app/backend/routes/kirmes.py::_create_kirmes_invoice_payment_link. ALL 3 TESTS PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_meter_freeze_iteration84.py::TestInvoicePaymentLink. Feature 2 (invoice payment link) is now FULLY WORKING end-to-end: POST /api/kirmes/invoices/{id}/send returns 200, persists payment_link_url + session_id + amount + created_at on the invoice, and inserts a payment_transactions row with status='pending' BEFORE the SMTP step. Fix confirmed: STRIPE_INVOICE_PAYMENT_METHODS env (default 'card') + card-only retry fallback works against preview Stripe test key. payment_link_error is NOT set on success.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean: STRIPE_INVOICE_PAYMENT_METHODS env var (default 'card') + automatic retry with card-only on rejection is a robust pattern that works on both preview and live Stripe accounts.
payment_link_error field is now persisted on failure with a truncated (300 chars) message and timestamp - admins can now diagnose broken buttons.
logger.error (was warning) upgrade is appropriate for a payment failure.
Reminder from previous iteration still applies: kirmes.py is 4422 lines - consider splitting into kirmes_events/kirmes_signups/kirmes_invoices/kirmes_meters modules for maintainability.
If PayPal should be enabled in production later, just set STRIPE_INVOICE_PAYMENT_METHODS='card,paypal' in backend/.env after activating PayPal in the Stripe dashboard - no code change required.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_meter_freeze_iteration84.py (added assertions for payment_link_amount, payment_link_created_at, payment_link_error negative check)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test used the existing open-balance invoice R26-K-0002 (Herbstkirmes Musterstadt 2026, brutto=119.00 EUR, no deposit_applied). Test now cleans/resets payment_link fields before each run so it's idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Stripe payment_methods fix is verified working on the preview environment. If PayPal is later activated in Stripe live dashboard, set STRIPE_INVOICE_PAYMENT_METHODS='card,paypal' in backend/.env. The card-only retry fallback in _create_kirmes_invoice_payment_link (kirmes.py L2790-2799) means even if the env is misconfigured with a payment method that isn't activated, the code will still create a working card-only checkout session and log a warning.
rca of the issue: Original issue (iteration_84): payment_methods=['card','paypal'] hard-coded, paypal not activated on preview Stripe key -> Stripe rejects, exception swallowed silently, no payment link on invoice. Fix (verified in this iteration): (1) payment_methods now read from STRIPE_INVOICE_PAYMENT_METHODS env with default 'card' - preview environment defaults to card-only. (2) Automatic fallback to ['card'] if the configured list is rejected and contains card. (3) On unrecoverable failure, payment_link_error + payment_link_error_at are persisted on the invoice for admin visibility. Verified DB state after /send: invoice R26-K-0002 now has payment_link_url=https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_a1V1FX..., payment_link_session_id=cs_test_a1V1FX..., payment_link_amount=119.0, payment_link_created_at set, payment_link_error absent. payment_transactions row created with type='invoice', payment_status='pending', session_id matching, amount=119.0 EUR.
